info.title: Room Management Public API
info.description: Server-authoritative public availability, quotes, booking HOLDs, OTP verification and guest access. Booking-detail and logout use HttpOnly session cookies; all other routes accept no credentials.

200.description: Active public room types with customer-safe descriptions, capacity and amenities. No physical-room or operational facts are exposed.
Available room types only; no physical-room identifiers are exposed.

post.description: Bounded server-orchestrated nearby availability search. Returns shifted check-in candidates within `expandMinutes` (max 120) for the same active property when the requested interval has limited supply. Read-only; never creates quotes, bookings, HOLDs, coupon reservations or any persistent state.

200.description: Available nearby candidates ordered by absolute shift, earlier/later tie-rule, offer amount, plan code and stable room-type id. No physical-room identifiers, housekeeping details or maintenance reasons are exposed.

post.description: Read-only server-computed eligible base plans for a room type and interval. Does not create a quote, HOLD, booking, or payment.

200.description: Active, price-complete eligible plan offers only; no physical-room identities.

post.description: Phase 8B advisory flexible-time recommendations. The response is non-reserving; the customer must explicitly run a normal quote to commit.

200.description: Advisory recommendation set. Always returns the exact-result pricing breakdown plus zero-to-three strictly cheaper, available alternatives.
Booking HOLD created. Server-calculated amount, status and expiry.
OTP challenge issued. Identical envelope for real and decoy paths; rate limits apply.
OTP verified. Sets the rm_guest_session_v1 HttpOnly cookie and returns a safe envelope.
Booking detail with masked contact. Contact is masked regardless of session scope.
Server-authoritative MoMo checkout handoff for the booking HOLD.
Non-secret server-derived provider readiness for customer actions.
All property payment providers with server-derived safe enabled state and availability reason.
Authoritative persisted payment status; browser return parameters have no authority.

get.description: Signed provider IPN. Raw duplicate query keys are rejected before settlement.
Read-only browser return boundary. Query parameters do not settle a payment.

post.description: Provider-to-provider signed IPN. This endpoint never accepts browser settlement authority.

204.description: IPN acknowledged; invalid payloads are safely rejected.

get.description: Read-only browser return boundary. Query parameters do not settle a payment.

200.description: Returns HOLD, EXPIRED or UNKNOWN — never an error code for known inputs.
Always returns loggedOutAt. Clears the rm_guest_session_v1 cookie via Set-Cookie Max-Age=0.

cookieAuth.name: rm_guest_session_v1
cookieAuth.description: HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Secure-in-production guest session cookie. Raw token is never returned in any JSON body.

InvalidRequest.description: Request body or parameters failed validation.

QuoteCreationUnavailable.description: The room is unavailable or pricing is not configured for the requested stay.

QuoteUnavailable.description: The requested quote does not exist (RFC 7807 type=quote-unavailable).

QuoteExpired.description: The requested quote has expired (RFC 7807 type=quote-expired).

BookingHoldConflict.description: Booking HOLD could not be created (room unavailable, allocation busy, quote already used or expired). RFC 7807 type is booking-hold-{code}.

BookingHoldCleanupRetry.description: Booking HOLD cleanup hit its safety bound and the request should be retried later. RFC 7807 type=booking-hold-stale-hold-cleanup-retry.

OtpInvalidOrExpired.description: The provided OTP is invalid or expired.

OtpRateLimited.description: OTP rate-limited (RFC 7807 type=otp-rate-limited). The Retry-After header and problem-detail body carry retryAfterSeconds.

GuestSessionRequired.description: No rm_guest_session_v1 cookie was presented (RFC 7807 type=guest-session-required).

BookingNotFound.description: The requested booking could not be found (RFC 7807 type=booking-not-found).

PaymentInitiationConflict.description: The booking cannot start a MoMo attempt in its current payment state.
